title: Work-tape symbol at a relative position
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a finite Turing machine, let $h$ be one of its work tapes, and let $d\in\mathbb{Z}$. The value is the symbol, if any, stored on tape $h$ at position $d$ relative to that tape’s head.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of a finite Turing machine
$h$ is a work tape of the machine
